claims.quote: A parameter written as a name and a schema, `["n", "value/number?"]`, is a contract: a call checks the argument as `schema/assert` does, before the body runs, so a misfit fails with `schema/assert`'s words and the functions it left start with the caller, as Racket blames the party that broke a contract.
Where the call waits for a logic variable, in a rule or a `find`, the check waits too and runs when the variable is bound, as plain code would run it
A match with no fallback on a parameter with a contract is checked to cover every value the contract allows: `lion check` and the graph editor warn when its cases leave one out.
